subject: DI04000171

body.en:
Definition

A timer counts an internal clock to measure elapsed time;a counter counts qualifying external transitions to measure events.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Each baseline timer has THx/TLxregisters.TMOD holds GATE,C/Tand M1/M0 for Timer1 in the upper nibble and Timer0 in the lower nibble.
  • TCON bits7..0are TF1,TR1,TF0,TR0,IE 1,IT1,IE 0,IT0.TRruns a timer and TFsignals overflow;external-interrupt control/status shares this SFR.
  • For Timer0 Mode1 internal timing with GATE=0,use TMOD=(TMOD&0xF0)|0x01;this preserves the Timer1 nibble.Stop timer,configure/load,clear old flag,then start and test the correct overflow.
  • GATE=1 requires the associated INT pin high as well as TR=1;it does not select an interrupt mode.C/T=1 selects external counting,T0=P3.4,T1=P3.5.

Complete standalone Keil C51 example

12 MHz classic12T

#include <reg51.h>
typedef unsigned char u8;
typedef unsigned int u16;
volatile u16 count;
void main(void) {TR0=0;P3|=0x10;TMOD=(TMOD&0xF0)|0x05;TH0=0;TL0=0;TF0=0;TR0=1;
 for(;;) {TR0=0;count=((u16)TH0<<8)|TL0;TR0=1;} }
Timer versus counter?

Internal clock counts time;external transitions count events.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Timer elapsed time માટે internal clock ગણે;counter events માટે qualifying external transitions ગણે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • દરેક timerમાં THx/TLx છે.TMODના upper nibbleમાં Timer1/lowerમાં Timer0 માટે GATE,C/T,M1/M0 છે.
  • TCON bits7..0 TF1,TR1,TF0,TR0,IE 1,IT1,IE 0,IT0 છે.TR timer ચલાવે/TF overflow બતાવે;external-interrupt bits પણ આ SFRમાં છે.
  • Timer0 Mode1 internal/GATE=0 માટે TMOD=(TMOD&0xF0)|0x01 લો;Timer1 nibble સાચવે.Timer stop કરી configure/load,old flag clear,પછી start/correct overflow test કરો.
  • GATE=1માં TR=1 ઉપરાંત associated INT pin high જોઈએ;તે interrupt mode પસંદ નથી કરતું.C/T=1 external counting:T0=P3.4,T1=P3.5.

સંપૂર્ણ Standalone Keil C51 ઉદાહરણ

12 MHz classic12T

#include <reg51.h>
typedef unsigned char u8;
typedef unsigned int u16;
volatile u16 count;
void main(void) {TR0=0;P3|=0x10;TMOD=(TMOD&0xF0)|0x05;TH0=0;TL0=0;TF0=0;TR0=1;
 for(;;) {TR0=0;count=((u16)TH0<<8)|TL0;TR0=1;} }
Timer/Counter ભેદ?

Internal clockથી time/external transitionsથી events ગણાય.

h.en: External event counting and capture discipline
h.gu: External Event counting તથા Capture discipline

body.en:
Definition

An external counter increments on recognised transitions at its designated timer input,not once for every iteration of a Cloop.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Classic 8051 recognises external falling edges using sampled input states;the input must satisfy high/low timing.For ideal classic sampling,the maximum count rate is limited to about fosc/24,not fosc.
  • Amechanical switch needs debouncing or a clean pulse source;use only approved5V-compatible isolated trainer pulses.No industrial voltage directly to T0/T1.
  • To read a coherent16-bit value,stop counting briefly when permitted or use a documented stable-read technique.Capture periods,overflow and input limits must be recorded.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

External counter તેના designated input પર recognised transitionsથી વધે,C loopની દરેક iterationથી નહીં.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Classic 8051 sampled inputથી falling edges ઓળખે;high/low timing પૂરી થવી જોઈએ.Ideal classic samplingમાં maximum rate આશરે fosc/24 છે,fosc નહીં.
  • Mechanical switch માટે debounce/clean pulse source જોઈએ;approved5V-compatible isolated trainer pulses જ લો.Industrial voltage સીધું T0/T1 પર નહીં.
  • Coherent16-bit value માટે permitted હોય ત્યારે counting briefly stop કરો કે documented stable-read લો.Capture period,overflow/input limits લખો.

body.en:
Definition

A timer mode determines register width,reload behaviour and resource sharing;the mode number is not a time unit.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Mode0:M1M0=00,13-bit count using THxand low5bits of TLx;capacity8192 counts.Mode1:01,16-bit count THx:TLx;capacity65536,no automatic reload.
  • Mode2:10,TLxcounts8-bits and reloads from THxon overflow;set both THxand initial TLxfor a consistent first interval.Capacity256 counts per full period.
  • Mode3:11 for Timer0 splits TL0 and TH0 into8-bit resources;TH0 uses TR1/TF1,so ordinary Timer1 control/interrupt assumptions no longer hold.Timer1 Mode3 stops its counting;special baud-rate use must follow the chip documentation.
  • Choose Mode1 for longer one-shot intervals,Mode2 for short repeated intervals/baud generation and Mode3 only with deliberate resource planning.Amode change may invalidate an existing UART or delay function.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Timer mode register width,reload/resource sharing નક્કી કરે;mode number time unit નથી.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Mode0:M1M0=00માં THx/low5bits TLxથી13-bit,8192 counts.Mode1:01માં THx:TLx16-bit,65536 counts તથા automatic reload નહીં.
  • Mode2:10માં TLx8-bit count કરે/overflow પર THxથી reload થાય.Consistent first interval માટે THx તથા initial TLx બંને સેટ કરો.Full period256 counts છે.
  • Timer0 Mode3:11માં TL0/TH0 અલગ8-bit resources બને;TH0 TR1/TF1 વાપરે,એટલે ordinary Timer1 assumptions નહીં.Timer1 Mode3 counting stop કરે;special baud use datasheet મુજબ જ.
  • લાંબા one-shot માટે Mode1,short repeated/baud માટે Mode2 અને resource planning સાથે જ Mode3 લો.Mode changeથી existing UART/delay બગડી શકે.

body.en:
Definition

Timer preload is the initial counter value chosen so that overflow occurs after a specified number of timer increments.

Assumptions,ordered derivation and checks

  1. Assume classic12T,C/T=0,GATE=0 and oscillator fosc;timer tick Ttick=12/fosc.Required counts N=t/Ttick=t fosc/12;choose an integer count and state rounding error.
  2. Mode1 overflows at65536,so preload R=65536−N;THx=R>>8,TLx=R&0xFF.For12MHzand1ms:N=1000,R=64536=FC18H,TH=FCH,TL=18H.
  3. Execution:stop→set TMOD nibble→load TH/TL→clear TF→start TR→wait for TF→stop/clear as the chosen design requires.Then repeat/reload explicitly;Mode1 does not reload itself.
  4. At12MHzone full16-bit interval is65.536ms;1sneeds multiple intervals or another scheduling method.1000nominal1msintervals give1splus software/reload overhead,not a certified exact1sdelay.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Timer preload એવો initial counter value છે,જેથી specified increments પછી overflow થાય.

ધારણાઓ,ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation તથા ચકાસણી

  1. Classic12T,C/T=0,GATE=0 તથા fosc ધારો;Ttick=12/fosc.Counts N=t/Ttick=t fosc/12 છે.Integer count પસંદ કરી rounding error લખો.
  2. Mode1 overflow65536 પર થાય,તેથી R=65536−N;THx=R>>8,TLx=R&0xFF.12MHz/1ms માટે N=1000,R=64536=FC18H,TH=FCH,TL=18H.
  3. Execution:stop→TMOD nibble→TH/TL load→TF clear→TR start→TF wait→design મુજબ stop/clear.પછી explicit reload કરો;Mode1 પોતે reload નથી થતું.
  4. 12MHz પર full16-bit interval65.536ms છે;1s માટે multiple intervals/scheduling જોઈએ.1000nominal1msથી1s સાથે software/reload overhead આવે,certified exact1s નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A square wave with equal HIGH/LOW durations has period T=2thalfand frequency f=1/(2thalf);one output toggle produces only a half cycle.

Assumptions,ordered derivation and checks

  1. For1kHz,T=1msand thalf=500µs.At12MHz12T,Mode1 would need500 counts,preload65536−500=65036=FE0CH;software reload/toggle time adds error.
  2. A250µs Mode2 tick needs250 counts,TH1=TL1=256−250=06H.Toggle the output on every second Timer1 overflow;two overflows give500µsand a full output cycle needs four.
  3. Auto-reload removes per-period software reload drift,but ISR synchronisation adds latency/jitter.If interrupts are blocked long enough to miss overflows,the software divider loses time.Measure rather than fabricate a1.000kHzscope reading.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Equal HIGH/LOWવાળા square waveમાં T=2thalf તથા f=1/(2thalf);એક output toggle માત્ર અડધું cycle બનાવે.

ધારણાઓ,ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation તથા ચકાસણી

  1. 1kHz માટે T=1ms/thalf=500µs.12MHz12T Mode1માં500 counts/preload65536−500=65036=FE0CH જોઈએ;software reload/toggleથી error ઉમેરાય.
  2. 250µs Mode2 tick માટે250 counts,TH1=TL1=256−250=06H.દરેક બીજા Timer1 overflow પર toggle કરો;બે overflow500µs/પૂર્ણ cycle ચાર overflow છે.
  3. Auto-reload software reload drift ઘટાડે,પણ ISR latency/jitter રહે.Interrupt લાંબું block થતાં overflow ચૂકે તો divider time ગુમાવે.1.000kHz scope reading બનાવવાને બદલે માપો.

body.en:
Definition

An interrupt is a hardware-supported transfer to a service routine in response to an enabled request,with a defined return mechanism.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Classic vectors:INT0=0003H,C51 interrupt0;Timer0=000BH,1;INT1=0013H,2;Timer1=001BH,3;serial=0023H,4.Reset starts0000Hbut is not an ordinary maskable interrupt.
  • There are five vector entries and six request flags when RI/TIare counted separately;both serial flags share one ISR.IE global EAand individual EX0,ET0,EX1,ET1,ESmust permit the request.
  • IT0/IT1select edge/level external requests;level must be released appropriately.Timer TFflags are cleared on accepted baseline interrupt vectoring;serial RI/TIneed explicit software handling.
  • Polling repeatedly checks a flag;interrupt service runs asynchronously between instructions and must preserve required context.Never call an ordinary return function as a substitute for correct ISR attribution/RETI.

Complete standalone Keil C51 example

12 MHz classic12T

#include <reg51.h>
typedef unsigned char u8;
typedef unsigned int u16;
sbit IN=P3^2;
sbit LED=P1^0;
volatile u8 event=0;
void external0_service(void) interrupt 0 {event=1;}
void main(void) {IN=1;LED=1;IT0=1;IE0=0;EX0=1;EA=1;
 for(;;) if(event) {EA=0;event=0;EA=1;LED=!LED;} }
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Interrupt enabled requestના જવાબમાં defined return mechanism સાથે service routine તરફ hardware-supported control transfer છે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Classic vectors:INT0=0003H,C51 interrupt0;Timer0=000BH,1;INT1=0013H,2;Timer1=001BH,3;serial=0023H,4.Reset0000Hથી શરૂ થાય,ordinary maskable interrupt નથી.
  • પાંચ vector entries/RI-TIને અલગ ગણતાં છ request flags છે;serial flags એક ISR share કરે.IEમાં EA તથા individual EX0,ET0,EX1,ET1,ES permit હોવા જોઈએ.
  • IT0/IT1 external edge/level પસંદ કરે;level યોગ્ય રીતે release થવો જોઈએ.Baseline timer TF accepted vectoringમાં clear થાય;serial RI/TI softwareથી handle કરો.
  • Polling flag વારંવાર જુએ;interrupt instructions વચ્ચે asynchronously ચાલે/required context સાચવે.Correct ISR attribute/RETIના બદલે ordinary function return નલો.

સંપૂર્ણ Standalone Keil C51 ઉદાહરણ

12 MHz classic12T

#include <reg51.h>
typedef unsigned char u8;
typedef unsigned int u16;
sbit IN=P3^2;
sbit LED=P1^0;
volatile u8 event=0;
void external0_service(void) interrupt 0 {event=1;}
void main(void) {IN=1;LED=1;IT0=1;IE0=0;EX0=1;EA=1;
 for(;;) if(event) {EA=0;event=0;EA=1;LED=!LED;} }

body.en:
Definition

Interrupt priority determines which pending service may preempt another;it differs from the software order of ordinary function calls.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Baseline IP has high/low priorities.High-priority service can interrupt low-priority service,same-level requests do not normally nest;fixed polling order resolves simultaneously pending requests at one level.
  • Keep ISR sbrief:clear/handle source,update a flag/counter and return.Display writes,blocking delays and modem waits belong in the main loop unless a carefully analysed design says otherwise.
  • volatilepreserves accesses but does not prevent lost read-modify-write updates or torn16-bit reads.Save and restore the previous interrupt-enable state for brief critical sections rather than blindly enabling interrupts afterwards.
  • Keil C51 interrupt n generates vector/RETI and context handling;usingbank options require consistent bank use by called functions.Do not casually use the main register bank for an ISR with incompatible assumptions.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Interrupt priority pending service કઈ બીજીને preempt કરી શકે તે નક્કી કરે;ordinary function call orderથી અલગ છે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Baseline IPમાં high/low priority છે.High lowને interrupt કરે;same-level સામાન્ય રીતે nest નથી થતા;એક levelના simultaneous requests fixed polling orderથી પસંદ થાય.
  • ISR ટૂંકી રાખો:source handle,flag/counter update,return.Display writes,blocking delay/modem wait સામાન્ય રીતે main loopમાં હોવા જોઈએ.
  • volatile access જાળવે,પણ lost update/torn16-bit read રોકતું નથી.Critical section પછી blindly enable કરવાને બદલે previous interrupt-enable state restore કરો.
  • Keil C51 interrupt n vector/RETI/context બનાવે;using bankમાં called functions consistent હોવી જોઈએ.Incompatible assumptions સાથે main bank ISRમાં નવાપરો.

body.en:
Aim and status

A source-listed laboratory guide for authorised simulation/trainer work;it is not a claim of performed measurements.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Suggested duration2h;source compulsoryno.Source Unit/COentry3is retained even if theory placement differs.
  • P1.0active-low buffered LED;12MHzclassic12T;Timer0 Mode1,FC18Hreload repeated1000 times.
  • Nominal1sbetween toggles gives nominal2sfull period;polling/reload overhead makes real elapsed time longer.Measure error and report it.
  • Resources:exact 8051 trainer or target simulator,correct programmer/headers,isolated current-limited supply and required approved instruments/components;check datasheets and reset-safe driver gating before power.
  • Procedure:identify target/clock→review pin map with power OFF→build and inspect warnings→load into simulator→check logic/watch variables→with teacher approval test the isolated trainer→record actual evidence and power down safely.
  • Fault finding:check supply/clock/reset/EA,port release/polarity,shared-pin conflicts,ground/reference,driver enable and software assumptions one at a time.No live rewiring or arbitrary supply changes.
  • Expected values above are calculated/reference behaviour,not recorded observations.Leave actual results,status,signatures and measured waveforms blank until genuine work is performed.

Complete standalone Keil C51 source

/* Classic 12T, 12 MHz. Timer0 owned here; nominal timing plus software overhead. */

    TMOD = (TMOD & 0xF0) | 0x01;
    while (n--) {
        TR0=0; TH0=0xFC; TL0=0x18; TF0=0; TR0=1;
        while (!TF0) { }
        TR0=0; TF0=0;
    }
}
sbit LED=P1^0;
void main(void) { LED=1; for (;;) { wait_ms(1000); LED=!LED; } }

Aim and status

A source-listed laboratory guide for authorised simulation/trainer work;it is not a claim of performed measurements.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Suggested duration2h;source compulsoryno.Source Unit/COentry3is retained even if theory placement differs.
  • Active-low P3.2switch;P1.1controls an approved active-HIGH driver/active buzzer,not the sounder current directly.

  • Resources:exact 8051 trainer or target simulator,correct programmer/headers,isolated current-limited supply and required approved instruments/components;check datasheets and reset-safe driver gating before power.

  • Fault finding:check supply/clock/reset/EA,port release/polarity,shared-pin conflicts,ground/reference,driver enable and software assumptions one at a time.No live rewiring or arbitrary supply changes.
  • Expected values above are calculated/reference behaviour,not recorded observations.Leave actual results,status,signatures and measured waveforms blank until genuine work is performed.
